publication_name: OECD data reuse, no series bound
access_description: The public SDMX API does not require a key. Registration is voluntary. No dataset was bound because third-party ownership was not ruled out.
auth_requirement: No API key is required. Registration is voluntary and was not used.
conditions: rights pending. Section 3 says that, except where additional restrictions apply, data may be extracted, downloaded, copied, adapted, distributed, shared and embedded for any purpose, even for commercial use, with OECD credit. The same section says data may be subject to third-party ownership and that the user must verify the source tab before incorporating the data.
revision_behaviour: No observations are stored. A later permitted file would be latest-revised, not a vintage panel.
unresolved_questions: No candidate dataset's source tab was confirmed free of third-party rights. No exchange rate, credit series, or energy price is stored.
evidence_note: rights pending. Terms last updated 1 July 2024. The permitted-use paragraph is conditional on there being no additional restrictions or third-party ownership. That condition was not cleared for a specific series, so the six operations stay unknown.
